words.enDefinition: source notation that directly represents a value

examples.en: Our lecturer asked whether the quoted greeting in the example counted as a string literal.
examples.zh: 讲师问，示例里加引号的问候语是否算字符串「字面量」。

examples.en: I replaced a numeric literal with a named constant so the purpose of the number was clear.
examples.zh: 我用一个命名常量替换了数字「字面量」，好说明这个数的用途。

words.enDefinition: a name used to identify a program entity

examples.en: The workshop asked us to choose an identifier for the variable holding our total score.
examples.zh: 工作坊要求我们给保存总分的变量选一个「标识符」。

examples.en: I checked whether the leading character was allowed in a Python identifier before renaming it.
examples.zh: 我先检查那个字符能不能用作 Python「标识符」的首字符，再改名。

collocations: use an identifier in an expression

words.enDefinition: the name used to refer to a variable in code

examples.en: Our tutor suggested a clearer variable name for the number of completed reading tasks.
examples.zh: 导师为已完成阅读任务的数量建议了一个更清楚的「变量名」。

examples.en: I corrected the variable name on the second line after noticing that one letter differed.
examples.zh: 我发现有一个字母不同，就修正了第二行的「变量名」。

words.enDefinition: associating a program name with a value or object

examples.en: In the Python exercise, name binding associated the label with the string on the right.
examples.zh: 在 Python 练习中，「名称绑定」将标签名与右边的字符串关联起来。

examples.en: Our diagram illustrated name binding by drawing an arrow from the name to the object.
examples.zh: 我们的图从名称画一条箭头指向对象，用来说明「名称绑定」。

words.enDefinition: a statement that stores a value or binds it to a target

examples.en: The assignment statement stored the new score in the variable before the program displayed it.
examples.zh: 这条「赋值语句」先将新分数保存到变量里，程序随后才显示分数。

examples.en: I moved the assignment statement above the line that used the result in our Python script.
examples.zh: 我把 Python 脚本里的「赋值语句」移到使用结果的那一行上面。

collocations: the target of an assignment statement

words.enDefinition: syntax indicating that a value is being assigned to a target

examples.en: The JavaScript worksheet highlighted the assignment operator between the counter and its new value.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习表高亮了计数器和新值之间的「赋值运算符」。

examples.en: Our tutor used a different colour for the assignment operator and the strict equality operator.
examples.zh: 导师用两种不同颜色标记「赋值运算符」和严格相等运算符。

collocations: the left side of an assignment operator

words.enDefinition: a construct that introduces a variable in a language requiring or supporting declarations

examples.en: The JavaScript example used a variable declaration to introduce a counter for the first time.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例用「变量声明」首次引入了一个计数器。

examples.en: I read the variable declaration at the top to see which name the exercise introduced.
examples.zh: 我查看顶部的「变量声明」，确认练习引入了哪个名称。

collocations: a variable declaration with an initializer

words.enDefinition: giving a variable its first value

examples.en: The tutor demonstrated variable initialization by setting a game's score counter to zero.
examples.zh: 导师把游戏分数计数器设为零，用来演示「变量初始化」。

examples.en: Our first JavaScript exercise placed variable initialization beside the declaration so both were easy to read.
examples.zh: 我们的第一道 JavaScript 练习把「变量初始化」和声明放在一起，方便阅读。

words.enDefinition: assigning a different value to an existing target

examples.en: The Python exercise showed reassignment when the same name later referred to a different score.
examples.zh: 当同一个名称后来指向不同分数时，Python 练习展示了「重新赋值」。

examples.en: The tutor traced the effects of reassignment by writing the previous and current values side by side.
examples.zh: 导师把先前的值和当前值并排列出，以追踪「重新赋值」的影响。

words.enDefinition: assigning one evaluated value to multiple targets in a single chain

examples.en: The Python demo used chained assignment to initialise both counters to zero in one statement.
examples.zh: Python 演示用一条「链式赋值」语句把两个计数器都初始化为零。

examples.en: The worksheet used chained assignment with an immutable string to illustrate how several names received it.
examples.zh: 练习表用「链式赋值」把一个不可变字符串赋给多个名称。

words.enDefinition: assigning individual parts of an array or object to separate targets

examples.en: The JavaScript example used destructuring assignment to name the two coordinates in a single statement.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例用一条「解构赋值」语句分别为两个坐标值命名。

examples.en: We used destructuring assignment to take the title field from a small JavaScript object.
examples.zh: 我们用「解构赋值」提取了一个小型 JavaScript 对象里的标题字段。

words.enDefinition: assignment that combines an operation with updating its target

examples.en: The Python demonstration used augmented assignment to add two points to the player's running score.
examples.zh: Python 演示用「增强赋值」给玩家的当前累计分数加两分。

examples.en: Our tutor compared augmented assignment using addition with the longer statement that reads and updates the total.
examples.zh: 导师比较了使用加法的「增强赋值」和先读总数再更新的较长语句。

collocations: the target of an augmented assignment

words.enDefinition: a name without an established value or object in that context

examples.en: The Python example produced an error because the expression tried to read an unbound name.
examples.zh: Python 示例报错，是因为表达式试图读取一个「未绑定名称」。

examples.en: I traced the unbound name back to a missing assignment in our practice example.
examples.zh: 我追查这个「未绑定名称」，发现练习示例缺少一条赋值语句。

collocations: an error for an unbound name

words.enDefinition: a binding that cannot be reassigned after initialisation

examples.en: In our JavaScript example, a read-only binding kept referring to the same object throughout the exercise.
examples.zh: 在 JavaScript 示例中，「只读绑定」在整个练习过程中始终指向同一个对象。

examples.en: The object contents could change while the read-only binding continued pointing at the same object.
examples.zh: 对象内容可以改变，而「只读绑定」仍指向同一个对象。

collocations: a read-only binding to an object

words.enDefinition: a symbolic name for a value intended to remain unchanged

examples.en: The student used a named constant for the number of minutes in an hour.
examples.zh: 学生把一小时的分钟数写成了「命名常量」。

examples.en: Our Python exercise used an uppercase name for the named constant that represented the daily limit.
examples.zh: Python 练习用大写名称表示代表每日上限的「命名常量」。

collocations: replace a literal with a named constant

words.zhGloss: 含义不明的硬编码数字
words.enDefinition: a numeric literal whose purpose is unclear from its context
acceptedZhAnswers: 含义不明的硬编码数字

examples.en: The number looked like a magic number until the class learned that it represented minutes.
examples.zh: 在同学们知道那个数表示分钟之前，它看起来像一个「含义不明的硬编码数字」。

examples.en: I replaced the magic number with a name that explained why the limit was set there.
examples.zh: 我把「含义不明的硬编码数字」改成了一个能说明限制用途的名称。

words.enDefinition: a special value marking a particular condition within data

examples.en: The worksheet used a sentinel value to mark the end of the sample list.
examples.zh: 练习表用一个「哨兵值」标记样本列表的末尾。

examples.en: We chose a sentinel value outside the range of valid scores in the class exercise.
examples.zh: 在课堂练习中，我们选择了一个不在有效分数区间内的「哨兵值」。

collocations: a sentinel value marking the end

words.enDefinition: a designated value representing the absence of a meaningful value

examples.en: The JavaScript example used a null value until the student selected a display colour.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例在学生选择显示颜色之前使用「空值」。

examples.en: I checked whether the null value in the worksheet indicated an unknown answer or a deliberate omission.
examples.zh: 我核对练习表中的「空值」表示答案未知，还是特意留空。

collocations: a field with a null value

words.enDefinition: the Python singleton commonly used to represent an absent value

examples.en: The classroom function returned a None value when the requested label could not be found.
examples.zh: 课堂函数找不到所需标签时，返回了一个「Python 的空值」。

examples.en: Our tutor distinguished the None value from the empty string shown beside it in the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师让我们区分练习中并排列出的「Python 的空值」和空字符串。

collocations: use a None value as a default

words.enDefinition: JavaScript's special value commonly produced when a value has not been supplied

examples.en: The sample returned an undefined value when the requested JavaScript object property was missing.
examples.zh: 示例中所查的 JavaScript 对象属性缺失时，返回了一个「JavaScript 的未定义值」。

examples.en: We saw an undefined value after declaring a JavaScript variable with let and supplying no initializer.
examples.zh: 用 let 声明 JavaScript 变量但未提供初始值后，我们看到了一个「JavaScript 的未定义值」。

collocations: a property with an undefined value

words.enDefinition: a value or connection that points to a particular object

examples.en: The Python diagram showed an object reference from each name to the same shared object.
examples.zh: Python 图演示了每个名称都通过「对象引用」指向同一个共享对象。

examples.en: Our exercise copied an object reference, so both variables could still reach the same object.
examples.zh: 练习复制了一个「对象引用」，所以两个变量仍能访问同一个对象。

words.enDefinition: the property of being the very same individual object

examples.en: The tutor used Python's is operator to check object identity for two names in the demonstration.
examples.zh: 导师用 Python 的 is 运算符检查演示中两个名称所指对象的「对象同一性」。

examples.en: We examined object identity after both names were made to refer to the same example list.
examples.zh: 两个名称都指向同一个示例列表后，我们考察了「对象同一性」。

words.enDefinition: equality based on the values being compared

examples.en: Our worksheet checked value equality by comparing two separate Python lists with the same contents.
examples.zh: 练习表比较了两个内容相同、但各自独立的 Python 列表，以检查是否「值相等」。

examples.en: The example used value equality to compare two scores calculated from different sequences of steps.
examples.zh: 示例使用「值相等」来比较用不同步骤算出来的两个分数。

collocations: compare two objects for value equality

words.enDefinition: a value whose contents cannot be changed after creation

examples.en: The Python string was an immutable value, so editing its text produced a new string.
examples.zh: Python 字符串是「不可变值」，因此编辑文本会生成新的字符串。

examples.en: Our tutor used an immutable value to show why both names could safely share it.
examples.zh: 导师用一个「不可变值」说明为什么两个名称可以共享它。

words.enDefinition: a value whose contents can change after creation

examples.en: Our Python list was a mutable value, so adding an item changed the same list.
examples.zh: 我们的 Python 列表是「可变值」，因此添加一项会改变原来的列表。

examples.en: Two labels referred to a mutable value, and both reflected the change made in class.
examples.zh: 两个标签都指向同一个「可变值」，因此两边都反映了课堂上作出的修改。

words.enDefinition: a classification that defines a value's permitted operations or representation

examples.en: The quiz asked which data type could represent the two answers to a true-or-false question.
examples.zh: 测验问，哪种「数据类型」能表示判断题的两种答案。

examples.en: I checked the data type after the script joined two scores end to end.
examples.zh: 脚本把两个分数拼接在一起后，我检查了「数据类型」。

collocations: values of the same data type

words.enDefinition: the type a value actually has while a program runs

examples.en: The Python worksheet printed the runtime type after replacing a number with a string.
examples.zh: Python 练习表在用字符串替换数字后打印了值的「运行时类型」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the runtime type before deciding which operation the sample value supported.
examples.zh: 导师先检查「运行时类型」，再判断样本值支持哪种运算。

words.enDefinition: a value belonging to a language's basic non-object types

examples.en: Our JavaScript example treated the short label as a primitive value of the String type.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例把短标签视为 String 类型的「原始值」。

examples.en: Students identified the primitive value in a JavaScript exercise that also contained two objects.
examples.zh: 在一个同时含有两个对象的 JavaScript 练习中，学生找出了「原始值」。

words.enDefinition: a type discipline that assigns and checks types using program information available before ordinary execution

examples.en: The tutor introduced static typing by showing a type mismatch caught before the program ran.
examples.zh: 导师通过一个在程序运行前发现的类型不匹配演示「静态类型机制」。

examples.en: Our class compared static typing across two teaching languages using the same small example.
examples.zh: 我们班用同一个小示例比较两种教学语言中的「静态类型机制」。

words.enDefinition: a type discipline in which the types of runtime values determine which operations are valid as the program runs

examples.en: Our Python exercise illustrated dynamic typing by assigning values of different types to one name.
examples.zh: Python 练习把不同类型的值赋给同一个名称，演示了「动态类型机制」。

examples.en: The tutor linked dynamic typing to the error raised when our Python program combined incompatible values.
examples.zh: 导师解释了 Python 程序组合不兼容的值时报错与「动态类型机制」有什么关系。

words.enDefinition: determining a type from available program information without an explicit annotation

examples.en: The teaching compiler used type inference to determine a variable's type from its initial value.
examples.zh: 教学编译器通过「类型推断」，根据初始值确定变量的类型。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how type inference also considered the types of operands in an expression.
examples.zh: 导师展示了「类型推断」怎样考虑表达式中操作数的类型。

words.enDefinition: written information stating the intended type of a program element

examples.en: The Python worksheet showed a type annotation indicating that the score should be an integer.
examples.zh: Python 练习表使用「类型注解」说明分数应该是整数。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why the type annotation could guide a checker without enforcing the value at runtime.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么「类型注解」能为检查器提供依据，却不在运行时强制要求该类型。

words.enDefinition: a type that permits a designated null value

examples.en: The worksheet used a nullable type so the field could hold a number or null.
examples.zh: 练习表用「可空类型」表示该字段既可以存数字，也可以存空值。

examples.en: Our tutor marked the score field with a nullable type because some results were unknown.
examples.zh: 因为有些成绩未知，导师用「可空类型」标示成绩字段。

collocations: a value of a nullable type

words.enDefinition: a disagreement between the expected type and the type supplied

examples.en: The Python exercise showed a type mismatch when the program tried adding a number to text.
examples.zh: Python 练习展示了程序尝试把数字和文本相加时出现的「类型不匹配」。

examples.en: I corrected the type mismatch by passing a number where the test expected one.
examples.zh: 我按测试要求传入数字，修正了「类型不匹配」。

words.enDefinition: a conversion requested directly in the program's code

examples.en: The example used explicit type conversion to turn a numeric string into a Python integer.
examples.zh: 示例用「显式类型转换」把数字字符串转成 Python 整数。

examples.en: Our tutor added explicit type conversion before passing the sample value to the arithmetic expression.
examples.zh: 导师先加上「显式类型转换」，再让样本值参与算术表达式。

collocations: a call for explicit type conversion

words.enDefinition: automatic conversion of a value to another type according to context

examples.en: The JavaScript example showed type coercion when a number was joined to a text label.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例展示了数字与文本标签拼接时发生的「隐式类型转换」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to predict type coercion before reading the JavaScript expression's actual result.
examples.zh: 导师请我们先预测「隐式类型转换」，再看 JavaScript 表达式的实际结果。

words.enDefinition: verification of a value's type while a program is running

examples.en: The Python example used a runtime type check before treating the supplied value as text.
examples.zh: Python 示例先执行「运行时类型检查」，再把传进来的值当作文本处理。

examples.en: Our tutor demonstrated how a runtime type check could identify an unexpected integer in the data.
examples.zh: 导师演示了「运行时类型检查」如何识别数据中意料之外的整数。

words.enDefinition: a numeric type used for numbers with no fractional part

examples.en: The class chose an integer type for counting the pages in each sample booklet.
examples.zh: 同学们选用「整数类型」来统计每本样本小册子的页数。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what range the integer type could represent in the worksheet's example language.
examples.zh: 导师问，练习表的示例语言中，这种「整数类型」可以表示多大的数值范围。

words.enDefinition: an integer that can represent negative and nonnegative values

examples.en: We used a signed integer because the temperature readings could fall below zero in January.
examples.zh: 我们使用「有符号整数」，因为一月份的气温读数可能低于零。

examples.en: The worksheet asked what the same bits meant when interpreted as a signed integer.
examples.zh: 练习表问，同一组位按「有符号整数」解读时表示什么。

words.enDefinition: an integer interpreted in a format with no negative values

examples.en: The exercise used an unsigned integer for a counter that could never become negative.
examples.zh: 练习给一个不会变为负数的计数器使用了「无符号整数」。

examples.en: Our tutor read the same eight bits as an unsigned integer in the second example.
examples.zh: 在第二个示例里，导师把同样的八个位解读为「无符号整数」。

words.enDefinition: an integer represented using a fixed number of bits

examples.en: The worksheet used a fixed-width integer with eight bits to keep the calculation small.
examples.zh: 练习表采用八位「固定宽度整数」，以缩小计算规模。

examples.en: Our class compared a fixed-width integer with Python's ordinary integers by examining their ranges.
examples.zh: 同学们通过考察表示范围，比较了「固定宽度整数」和 Python 的普通整数。

collocations: the range of a fixed-width integer

words.enDefinition: an integer whose bit count can grow as needed

examples.en: The Python demonstration used an arbitrary-precision integer to store the product of two large numbers.
examples.zh: Python 演示用「任意精度整数」存储两个大数的乘积。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why an arbitrary-precision integer might need more memory as its value grows.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么「任意精度整数」的数值越大，可能需要的内存越多。

words.enDefinition: an integer result falling outside the type's representable range

examples.en: The worksheet flagged integer overflow when our toy counter exceeded the range permitted by its type.
examples.zh: 练习表用来演示的小计数器超出类型所允许的范围时，标记了「整数溢出」。

examples.en: We discussed why integer overflow could behave differently across the exercise's two example languages.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么「整数溢出」在练习所用两种示例语言中的表现可能不同。

words.enDefinition: arithmetic that cycles through a fixed range when a boundary is crossed

examples.en: The worksheet used wraparound arithmetic to show a tiny unsigned counter returning to zero.
examples.zh: 练习表用「回绕运算」演示一个位宽很小的无符号计数器回到零。

examples.en: Our tutor compared wraparound arithmetic with a calculator that simply stopped at its maximum value.
examples.zh: 导师将「回绕运算」与到达最大值就停止计数的计算器作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a common signed integer encoding with a negative top-bit weight

examples.en: The class wrote negative three in two's complement using the fixed width specified on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 同学们采用练习表规定的固定宽度，用「二进制补码」写出了负三。

examples.en: Our tutor used two's complement to explain why the highest bit contributed a negative amount.
examples.zh: 导师用「二进制补码」解释为什么最高位的贡献值为负。

collocations: represent an integer in two's complement

words.enDefinition: a bit that indicates the sign of a value in a specified format

examples.en: The sign bit was set in the worksheet's encoding of a negative signed integer.
examples.zh: 练习表对负的有符号整数进行编码时，设置了「符号位」。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed out the sign bit in two floating-point values with equal magnitudes.
examples.zh: 导师指出了两个绝对值相等的浮点值中的「符号位」。

collocations: the position of the sign bit

words.enDefinition: division whose quotient is rounded toward negative infinity

examples.en: In Python, floor division of negative five by two gives negative three in our worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习表中的 Python 示例里，负五除以二作「向下取整除法」得到负三。

examples.en: The tutor compared floor division with ordinary division when the numbers did not divide evenly.
examples.zh: 两个数除不尽时，导师比较了「向下取整除法」和普通除法。

words.enDefinition: division whose quotient is rounded toward zero

examples.en: The JavaScript BigInt example used truncating division, so negative five divided by two gave negative two.
examples.zh: JavaScript 的 BigInt 示例采用「向零截断除法」，所以负五除以二得到负二。

examples.en: Our tutor compared truncating division with floor division using the same negative numerator in both cases.
examples.zh: 导师用同一个负数作为分子，比较了「向零截断除法」和向下取整除法。

words.enDefinition: division such as Python's slash operation that can produce a fractional quotient instead of rounding it to an integer

examples.en: In Python, true division of two integers can produce a fractional value in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，Python 的两个整数作「真除法」可以得到带小数的值。

examples.en: The worksheet used true division to calculate the average of three different reading scores.
examples.zh: 练习表用「真除法」计算三个不同阅读分数的平均值。

words.enDefinition: an operator giving the nonnegative residue for a positive modulus

examples.en: The Python worksheet used the modulo operator to find the position within a repeating sequence.
examples.zh: Python 练习表用「模运算符」找出某项在循环序列中的位置。

examples.en: With a positive divisor, Python's modulo operator returned a nonnegative result in the sample calculation.
examples.zh: 除数为正时，样本计算中的 Python「模运算符」给出非负结果。

collocations: the modulo operator with a positive divisor

words.enDefinition: an operator giving a division remainder, with JavaScript preserving the dividend's sign

examples.en: The JavaScript remainder operator gave negative two for negative five divided by three in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂上，负五除以三用 JavaScript「余数运算符」得到负二。

examples.en: Our tutor contrasted the remainder operator in JavaScript with Python's modulo operator using negative values.
examples.zh: 导师用负数对比了 JavaScript 的「余数运算符」和 Python 的模运算符。

collocations: apply the remainder operator to integers

words.enDefinition: to round an exact halfway value to the even candidate

examples.en: We had to round half to even, so the exact halfway value of 2.5 became two.
examples.zh: 我们采用「舍入中点时取偶」的规则，把刚好在中点的 2.5 舍入为二。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to round half to even for both ties in the example.
examples.zh: 导师要求我们对示例中两个刚好在中点的数都采用「舍入中点时取偶」。

collocations: round half to even at a tie
the round half to even rule
choose to round half to even

words.enDefinition: a number represented with a scaled significand and limited precision

examples.en: The program used a floating-point number to represent the measured length in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 程序用一个「浮点数」表示课堂示例中测得的长度。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the printed digits fully described the value of the floating-point number.
examples.zh: 导师问，打印出来的数字能否完全描述这个「浮点数」的实际值。

words.enDefinition: floating-point representation using powers of two for scaling

examples.en: The worksheet showed why binary floating point could represent one half exactly but only approximate one tenth.
examples.zh: 练习表说明，为什么「二进制浮点」能精确表示二分之一，却只能近似表示十分之一。

examples.en: Our tutor compared binary floating point with a calculation using exact decimal quantities in class.
examples.zh: 导师在课堂上将「二进制浮点」与使用精确十进制数值的计算作了比较。

words.enDefinition: floating-point precision commonly implemented with the binary32 format

examples.en: The worksheet used single precision to show how a smaller format retained fewer significant bits.
examples.zh: 练习表用「单精度」来演示，较小的格式能保留的有效位更少。

examples.en: In the JavaScript demo, a Float32Array stored our sample readings rounded to single precision.
examples.zh: 在 JavaScript 演示中，Float32Array 将样本读数舍入至「单精度」后存储。

collocations: convert a value to single precision

words.enDefinition: floating-point precision commonly implemented with the binary64 format

examples.en: The exercise compared double precision with a smaller format when storing the same fractional value.
examples.zh: 存储同一个小数值时，练习比较了「双精度」和一种较小的格式。

examples.en: JavaScript Number arithmetic used double precision in the sample, but some decimal fractions remained inexact.
examples.zh: 示例中的 JavaScript Number 运算使用「双精度」，但有些十进制小数仍只能近似表示。

collocations: a value stored in double precision

words.enDefinition: the significant digits of a floating-point value before exponent scaling

examples.en: The worksheet separated the significand from the exponent in a small floating-point example.
examples.zh: 练习表在一个小型浮点示例中把「有效数字部分」与指数分开列出。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which value had more bits available for its significand in the comparison.
examples.zh: 导师问，在这项比较中，哪个值的「有效数字部分」有更多可用位。

words.enDefinition: the power that specifies the scale in a numeric representation

examples.en: The exponent in our binary example told us which power of two to use.
examples.zh: 我们二进制示例中的「指数」指明要用二的哪一个幂。

examples.en: We changed the exponent in the worksheet while keeping the significand the same throughout.
examples.zh: 我们在练习表中改变「指数」，同时保持有效数字部分始终不变。

words.enDefinition: a nonzero float smaller in magnitude than the smallest normal value

examples.en: The exercise located a subnormal number between zero and the smallest positive normal floating-point number.
examples.zh: 练习在零和最小正正规浮点数之间找到了一个「次正规数」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why a subnormal number could retain fewer significant bits in the illustrated format.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么在所示格式中，「次正规数」可能保留更少的有效位。

words.enDefinition: zero represented with a positive or negative sign in some numeric formats

examples.en: The tutor used signed zero to show why two equal numeric results could have different representations.
examples.zh: 导师用「带符号的零」说明为什么两个相等的数值结果可以用不同方式表示。

examples.en: Our JavaScript worksheet showed signed zero by comparing positive zero and negative zero with Object.is.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习表用 Object.is 比较正零和负零，以展示「带符号的零」。

words.enDefinition: the condition in which a result's magnitude is too small for normal representation and may lose precision or round to zero

examples.en: The worksheet illustrated floating-point underflow by rounding a tiny positive result down to zero.
examples.zh: 练习表把一个极小的正数舍入为零，演示「浮点下溢」。

examples.en: Our tutor used floating-point underflow to discuss the limited range of the small demonstration format.
examples.zh: 导师用「浮点下溢」讨论小型演示格式有限的表示范围。

words.enDefinition: a special numeric value representing an invalid or undefined numeric result

examples.en: The JavaScript demonstration produced NaN when it tried to convert the sample word into a number.
examples.zh: JavaScript 演示尝试把样本单词转成数字时，得到「非数值」。

examples.en: Our tutor used a dedicated test to detect NaN in the results of the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师用专门的检测方法从练习结果中找出「非数值」。

words.enDefinition: the difference introduced when a result is rounded to available precision

examples.en: A small rounding error appeared after the worksheet added several decimal fractions in binary floating point.
examples.zh: 练习表用二进制浮点相加几个十进制小数后，出现了很小的「舍入误差」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how rounding error could accumulate when the same calculation was repeated many times.
examples.zh: 导师问，同一个计算做很多次时，「舍入误差」可能怎样累积。

words.enDefinition: loss of finer numerical distinctions during storage, conversion, or calculation

examples.en: The JavaScript worksheet showed precision loss after converting a sufficiently large BigInt into a Number.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习表演示了把一个足够大的 BigInt 转为 Number 后的「精度损失」。

examples.en: Our tutor identified precision loss when two nearby results became identical in the storage format.
examples.zh: 两个相近结果在存储格式中变得相同时，导师确认发生了「精度损失」。

words.enDefinition: agreement within a specified numerical tolerance

examples.en: The class used approximate equality to compare two computed lengths that differed slightly after rounding.
examples.zh: 同学们使用「近似相等」来比较两个舍入后略有差异的计算长度。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to state a tolerance before checking approximate equality in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师让我们先确定容差，再在练习表里检查是否「近似相等」。

words.enDefinition: a number represented by an integer with a constant scale

examples.en: The worksheet represented centimetres as a fixed-point number by storing measurements in whole millimetres.
examples.zh: 练习表用整数毫米存储测量值，从而用「定点数」表示厘米。

examples.en: Our tutor labelled the scale beside each fixed-point number so the class could interpret it.
examples.zh: 导师在每个「定点数」旁标注缩放比例，方便同学们解读。

words.enDefinition: writing a number as a coefficient multiplied by a power of ten

examples.en: The worksheet used scientific notation to write a small measurement without a long string of zeros.
examples.zh: 练习表用「科学计数法」写一个很小的测量值，省去一长串零。

examples.en: Our tutor rewrote the same value in scientific notation before entering it in the example.
examples.zh: 导师先用「科学计数法」改写同一数值，再将其输入示例。

collocations: write a number in scientific notation

words.zhGloss: JavaScript 任意精度整数类型
words.enDefinition: JavaScript's primitive type for integers of arbitrary magnitude
acceptedZhAnswers: JavaScript 任意精度整数类型

examples.en: The JavaScript exercise used BigInt to keep a very large classroom counter exact.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习用「JavaScript 任意精度整数类型」精确保存一个很大的课堂计数值。

examples.en: Our tutor marked the final lowercase n on a BigInt literal in the sample.
examples.zh: 导师在样本的「JavaScript 任意精度整数类型」字面量上标出了末尾的小写 n。

collocations: convert an integer to a BigInt

words.enDefinition: a JavaScript Number integer with magnitude at most two to the fifty-third power minus one, so no other integer rounds to it

examples.en: The worksheet checked whether the computed JavaScript Number was a safe integer after combining large values.
examples.zh: 练习表在组合多个大数后，检查算得的 JavaScript Number 值是否为「安全整数」。

examples.en: Our tutor used Number.isSafeInteger to check that the result remained a safe integer in JavaScript.
examples.zh: 导师用 Number.isSafeInteger 检查 JavaScript 的计算结果是否仍为「安全整数」。

words.enDefinition: a numeric value that is neither infinite nor NaN

examples.en: The JavaScript worksheet used Number.isFinite to check whether each computed result was a finite number.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习表用 Number.isFinite 检查每个计算结果是否为「有限数值」。

examples.en: Our tutor separated each finite number from the infinite results before plotting the sample values.
examples.zh: 导师在绘制样本数据前，把各个「有限数值」与无穷值分开。

words.enDefinition: a value representing true or false

examples.en: The classroom program stored a boolean value indicating whether the drawing was complete.
examples.zh: 课堂程序保存了一个「布尔值」，表示图画是否完成。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what boolean value the comparison would produce for the two equal numbers.
examples.zh: 导师问，比较两个相等的数会产生什么「布尔值」。

collocations: convert a value to a boolean value

words.enDefinition: evaluating a value as true or false in a condition

examples.en: The Python worksheet used truth value testing to decide whether an empty string counted as false.
examples.zh: Python 练习表用「真值测试」判断空字符串是否被视为假。

examples.en: We compared truth value testing for two values before tracing the example's result in class.
examples.zh: 我们先比较两个值的「真值测试」结果，再在课堂上追踪示例结果。

words.enDefinition: treated as true when tested in a Boolean context

examples.en: The JavaScript worksheet showed that a nonempty text value was truthy in the sample test.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习表展示，在样本测试中，非空文本值「在条件中被视为真」。

examples.en: We marked the empty array as truthy in JavaScript before comparing the same idea in Python.
examples.zh: 比较 Python 中的相应情况之前，我们先把 JavaScript 的空数组标记为「在条件中被视为真的」。

collocations: test whether a value is truthy

words.enDefinition: treated as false when tested in a Boolean context

examples.en: The JavaScript exercise marked the empty string as falsy when it was used in a condition.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习中，空字符串「在条件中被视为假」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed why numeric zero was falsy even though the text string containing zero was truthy.
examples.zh: 导师演示，为什么数字零「在条件中被视为假」，而字符零组成的字符串被视为真。

words.enDefinition: a conjunction true only when both Boolean operands are true

examples.en: The sample used logical AND to combine two true-or-false answers from the practice quiz.
examples.zh: 样本用「逻辑与」合并练习测验中的两个判断题答案。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the logical AND result when only one of the conditions was true.
examples.zh: 导师检查了只有一个条件为真时的「逻辑与」结果。

words.enDefinition: a disjunction true when at least one Boolean operand is true

examples.en: The worksheet used logical OR to check whether either of the two lights was on.
examples.zh: 练习表用「逻辑或」检查两盏灯中是否至少有一盏亮着。

examples.en: We included the case where both conditions were true in the logical OR exercise.
examples.zh: 在「逻辑或」练习中，我们也考虑了两个条件都为真的情况。

words.enDefinition: an operation that reverses a truth value

examples.en: The classroom example applied logical NOT to reverse the result of a comparison.
examples.zh: 课堂示例用「逻辑非」反转比较结果。

examples.en: Our tutor used logical NOT to turn the single false answer into a true one.
examples.zh: 导师用「逻辑非」把唯一的假值转换为真值。

collocations: invert a truth value with logical NOT

words.enDefinition: skipping a later operand when the result is already determined

examples.en: A JavaScript AND expression used short-circuit evaluation to skip its second test when the first was false.
examples.zh: 一个 JavaScript 逻辑与表达式采用「短路求值」，第一个测试为假时就跳过第二个测试。

examples.en: Our tutor illustrated short-circuit evaluation by marking only the expressions that the program had evaluated.
examples.zh: 导师只标出了程序实际求值的表达式，用来说明「短路求值」。

words.enDefinition: JavaScript equality testing without type coercion

examples.en: The JavaScript worksheet used strict equality to compare a number with a string containing the same digits.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习表用「严格相等」比较一个数字和包含相同数字字符的字符串。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why strict equality returned false for the two values in the sample.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么样本中的两个值作「严格相等」比较会得到假。

words.enDefinition: JavaScript equality testing that applies conversion rules to some operands

examples.en: The exercise used loose equality to compare the number zero with a string containing zero.
examples.zh: 练习用「宽松相等」比较数字零与含字符零的字符串。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which conversion took place before loose equality gave its result in JavaScript.
examples.zh: 导师问，JavaScript 的「宽松相等」给出结果前发生了哪种转换。

words.enDefinition: base-two representation using the digits zero and one

examples.en: The worksheet wrote the same small number in binary notation and in ordinary decimal notation.
examples.zh: 练习表用「二进制记数法」和普通十进制记数法写出同一个小数字。

examples.en: Our tutor used binary notation to show how two positions added up to the sample value.
examples.zh: 导师用「二进制记数法」说明两个数位的位权如何相加得到样本值。

collocations: write a value in binary notation

words.enDefinition: base-ten representation using the digits zero through nine

examples.en: The class converted a short binary value to decimal notation before checking the answer.
examples.zh: 学生先把一个简短的二进制值转为「十进制记数法」，再核对答案。

examples.en: Our tutor used decimal notation to explain why the leftmost digit carried a larger weight.
examples.zh: 导师用「十进制记数法」解释为什么最左边的数字有更大的位权。

collocations: write a number in decimal notation

words.enDefinition: base-sixteen representation using digits and the letters A through F

examples.en: The worksheet expressed one byte in hexadecimal notation using two digits for the display.
examples.zh: 练习表用「十六进制记数法」表示一个字节，显示为两个数位。

examples.en: I used hexadecimal notation to read the small colour values printed beside the sample drawing.
examples.zh: 我用「十六进制记数法」读出样本图旁印出的几个简短颜色值。

collocations: write a value in hexadecimal notation

words.enDefinition: base-eight representation using the digits zero through seven

examples.en: Our tutor grouped the binary digits in threes to illustrate conversion to octal notation.
examples.zh: 导师把二进制数字每三位分成一组，展示如何转为「八进制记数法」。

examples.en: The exercise displayed a small number in octal notation next to its original decimal representation.
examples.zh: 练习把一个小数字按「八进制记数法」列在它原来的十进制表示旁。

collocations: write a value in octal notation
express a number in octal notation

words.enDefinition: writing the same numeric value in a different base

examples.en: The class practised base conversion by rewriting several small decimal numbers in binary notation.
examples.zh: 同学们练习「进制转换」，把几个小的十进制数改写成二进制。

examples.en: I checked the base conversion by reading the new digits back as the original value.
examples.zh: 我把新的数字读回原数值，以核对「进制转换」的结果。

words.enDefinition: a binary unit with a value of zero or one

examples.en: The diagram used one bit to record whether the classroom lamp was on or off.
examples.zh: 图中用一个「比特」记录教室里的灯是亮还是灭。

examples.en: Our tutor changed the last bit in the example and asked us to recalculate the value.
examples.zh: 导师改变示例中的最后一个「比特」，请我们重新计算数值。

words.enDefinition: a customary unit of digital data consisting of eight bits

examples.en: The worksheet grouped eight bits into one byte before showing the value in hexadecimal.
examples.zh: 练习表先把八个位合成一个「字节」，再用十六进制显示该值。

examples.en: I compared the number of characters with the byte count for a short encoded greeting.
examples.zh: 我比较了一句简短问候在编码后的字符数和「字节」数。

words.enDefinition: a particular sequence of zero and one bits

examples.en: The same bit pattern represented different numbers when we changed the interpretation in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上改变解读方式后，同一个「位模式」表示了不同的数字。

examples.en: Our worksheet highlighted the bit pattern that represented the student team's test value.
examples.zh: 练习表高亮了表示学生团队测试值的「位模式」。

words.enDefinition: the number of bits used in a representation

examples.en: The worksheet changed the bit width from four to eight before repeating the calculation.
examples.zh: 练习表把「位宽」从四改为八，然后重复计算。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how a larger bit width affected the range of representable integers.
examples.zh: 导师问，增大「位宽」会怎样影响可表示的整数范围。

words.enDefinition: the bit with the greatest weight magnitude in a positional representation

examples.en: The worksheet marked the most significant bit before we interpreted the sample as an unsigned integer.
examples.zh: 在我们把样本解读为无符号整数前，练习表标出了「最高有效位」。

examples.en: Our tutor moved the most significant bit to a separate column so students could compare its weight.
examples.zh: 导师把「最高有效位」放进单独一栏，以便学生比较它的位权。

collocations: the weight of the most significant bit

words.enDefinition: the bit with the smallest positional weight

examples.en: The class changed the least significant bit to see how the unsigned number would change.
examples.zh: 学生改变「最低有效位」，观察无符号数值会发生什么变化。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the least significant bit to see whether the example integer was odd.
examples.zh: 导师检查「最低有效位」，判断示例整数是不是奇数。

words.enDefinition: a pattern of bits used to select or modify particular positions

examples.en: We used a bit mask to highlight two positions in the sample pattern of bits.
examples.zh: 我们用一个「位掩码」标出样本位模式里的两个位置。

examples.en: The tutor drew the bit mask above the original value so the selected positions lined up.
examples.zh: 导师把「位掩码」画在原值上面，让被选中的位置对齐。

collocations: select bits with a bit mask

words.enDefinition: an operation giving one where both input bits are one

examples.en: The worksheet used bitwise AND to keep only the positions selected by a mask.
examples.zh: 练习表用「按位与」保留掩码选中的位置。

examples.en: Our tutor practised bitwise AND with two short binary numbers before introducing a longer example.
examples.zh: 导师先用两个简短的二进制数练习「按位与」，再介绍更长的示例。

words.enDefinition: an operation giving one wherever at least one input bit is one

examples.en: The class used bitwise OR to merge two patterns representing lamps that had been switched on.
examples.zh: 同学们用「按位或」合并两个表示哪些灯已打开的位模式。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what bitwise OR would produce where both input bits were already one.
examples.zh: 导师问，两个输入位都为一时，「按位或」会得到什么结果。

collocations: combine bit patterns with bitwise OR

words.enDefinition: an operation giving one wherever the two input bits differ

examples.en: The worksheet used bitwise XOR to mark positions where its two patterns were different.
examples.zh: 练习表用「按位异或」标记两个位模式中不同的位置。

examples.en: Our tutor applied bitwise XOR to identical bit patterns and asked us to interpret the result.
examples.zh: 导师对相同的位模式执行「按位异或」，并请我们解读结果。

collocations: compare bit patterns with bitwise XOR

words.enDefinition: inverting each bit in the representation used by an operation

examples.en: We found the bitwise complement by switching each zero and one in the eight-bit example.
examples.zh: 我们互换八位示例中的每个零和一，得到了「按位取反」的结果。

examples.en: Our tutor fixed the width before asking us to calculate the bitwise complement on paper.
examples.zh: 导师先确定了位宽，再请我们在纸上计算「按位取反」的结果。

words.enDefinition: moving bits toward higher positions and filling lower positions with zeros

examples.en: The worksheet used a left shift to move the sample bits one position toward the higher end.
examples.zh: 练习表用「左移」把样本位向高位方向移动一位。

examples.en: Our tutor used a left shift on a small Python integer before checking the numeric result.
examples.zh: 导师对一个小的 Python 整数执行「左移」，然后核对数值结果。

collocations: a left shift by one position

words.enDefinition: moving bits down while extending the sign into the vacated positions

examples.en: The fixed-width example used an arithmetic right shift and filled the new top positions with ones.
examples.zh: 固定宽度示例采用「算术右移」，用一填充新腾出的高位。

examples.en: Our tutor used an arithmetic right shift to show that the negative result kept its sign.
examples.zh: 导师用「算术右移」演示负数结果保持原来的符号。

collocations: the result of an arithmetic right shift
an arithmetic right shift by two

words.enDefinition: moving bits down and filling vacated high positions with zeros

examples.en: The worksheet used a logical right shift to move the bits while inserting zeros at the top.
examples.zh: 练习表用「逻辑右移」移动各位，同时在高位填零。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the logical right shift with a shift that copied the old sign bit.
examples.zh: 导师把「逻辑右移」和一种复制原符号位的移位操作作了比较。

collocations: a logical right shift by one

words.enDefinition: the order used to store a multi-byte numeric value

examples.en: We marked the endianness beside each two-byte example so everyone could read the value consistently.
examples.zh: 我们在每个双字节示例旁标出「字节序」，让大家用一致的方式读取数值。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why changing the endianness could change the interpretation of the same stored bytes.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么更改「字节序」可能改变对同一串已存储字节的解读。

collocations: the endianness of a byte sequence

words.enDefinition: storing the most significant byte at the lowest address or first in sequence

examples.en: The big-endian example put the most significant byte first in the two-byte sequence on the board.
examples.zh: 黑板上的「大端序」示例把最高有效字节放在双字节序列的开头。

examples.en: Our tutor read the big-endian sequence from the stated order before converting it to decimal.
examples.zh: 导师先按规定顺序读取「大端序」字节序列，再把它转换成十进制。

collocations: store a value in big-endian format

words.enDefinition: storing the least significant byte at the lowest address or first in sequence

examples.en: The little-endian example placed the least significant byte first in the worksheet's two-byte sequence.
examples.zh: 「小端序」示例把最低有效字节放在练习表双字节序列的开头。

examples.en: We identified the little-endian representation by checking where the lowest-weight byte appeared in the example.
examples.zh: 我们检查示例中最低有效字节的位置，识别出了「小端序」表示。

collocations: read a value in little-endian format

words.enDefinition: an ordered sequence of units representing text

examples.en: The classroom program stored the student's short display name as a text string.
examples.zh: 课堂程序把学生的简短显示名称存为「文本字符串」。

examples.en: Our tutor drew a text string as a row of adjacent positions on the board.
examples.zh: 导师在黑板上把「文本字符串」画成了一排相邻的位置。

words.enDefinition: source notation that directly represents a string

examples.en: The Python worksheet used a string literal to supply the greeting printed by the program.
examples.zh: Python 练习表用「字符串字面量」给出程序打印的问候语。

examples.en: I added the closing quote after the editor marked the unfinished string literal on line three.
examples.zh: 编辑器标出第三行未结束的「字符串字面量」后，我补上了结束引号。

collocations: the end of a string literal

words.enDefinition: a sequence of byte values stored as one value

examples.en: The Python example read a short byte string before interpreting it as text.
examples.zh: Python 示例先读入一小段「字节串」，再把它解释为文本。

examples.en: Our tutor showed the byte string as hexadecimal values beside the decoded greeting.
examples.zh: 导师把「字节串」表示为十六进制值，列在解码后的问候语旁边。

collocations: the length of a byte string

words.enDefinition: a literal in which backslashes generally remain in the text

examples.en: The Python worksheet used a raw string literal to preserve the backslashes in the example.
examples.zh: Python 练习表用「原始字符串字面量」保留示例中的反斜杠。

examples.en: Our tutor highlighted the prefix marking the raw string literal in the Python sample.
examples.zh: 导师高亮了 Python 样本中标记「原始字符串字面量」的前缀。

words.enDefinition: source characters representing a character or action indirectly

examples.en: The worksheet inserted an escape sequence to place a line break inside the greeting.
examples.zh: 练习表插入了一个「转义序列」，在问候语中加进换行。

examples.en: Our tutor checked which escape sequence represented a tab in the sample source code.
examples.zh: 导师检查了样本源代码中哪个「转义序列」表示制表符。

collocations: an escape sequence for a newline

words.enDefinition: a marker showing where a string literal begins or ends

examples.en: The editor highlighted the opening string delimiter after I omitted the closing quote in the example.
examples.zh: 我漏写示例中的结束引号后，编辑器高亮了开头的「字符串定界符」。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed to the backtick used as a string delimiter in the JavaScript demonstration.
examples.zh: 导师指出 JavaScript 演示中作为「字符串定界符」的反引号。

collocations: a quote used as a string delimiter

words.enDefinition: a string containing text on more than one line

examples.en: The Python worksheet stored the three-line poem as one multiline string for the exercise.
examples.zh: Python 练习表把一首三行诗存为一个「多行字符串」供练习使用。

examples.en: We displayed the multiline string and counted the line breaks in the resulting text.
examples.zh: 我们显示了「多行字符串」，并数了结果文本中的换行。

words.enDefinition: JavaScript backtick syntax for strings with optional embedded expressions

examples.en: The JavaScript example used a template literal to insert the score into a short message.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例用「模板字面量」把分数放进一条简短消息。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how the template literal kept the line break in the sample greeting.
examples.zh: 导师演示了「模板字面量」如何保留样本问候语里的换行。

collocations: an expression inside a template literal

words.enDefinition: Python string literal syntax that evaluates embedded expressions

examples.en: The formatted string literal placed the calculated average between two pieces of ordinary text.
examples.zh: 「格式化字符串字面量」把算出的平均值放在两段普通文字之间。

examples.en: Our Python worksheet used a formatted string literal to display the reading with two decimal places.
examples.zh: Python 练习表用「格式化字符串字面量」显示保留两位小数的读数。

collocations: an expression inside a formatted string literal

words.enDefinition: notation describing how a value should appear as text

examples.en: The Python example used a format specifier to show the measured length with two decimal places.
examples.zh: Python 示例用「格式说明符」把测得的长度显示为两位小数。

examples.en: Our tutor changed the format specifier and asked why the underlying numeric value stayed the same.
examples.zh: 导师改了「格式说明符」，问为什么底层数值保持不变。

words.enDefinition: embedding evaluated values into surrounding text

examples.en: The classroom website used string interpolation to place a name inside its welcome message.
examples.zh: 课堂网站用「字符串插值」在欢迎消息里插入姓名。

examples.en: Our tutor traced string interpolation by showing the expression and the text it produced.
examples.zh: 导师把表达式和它产生的文本一起展示，以追踪「字符串插值」。

collocations: an expression used in string interpolation

words.enDefinition: joining text sequences end to end

examples.en: The worksheet used string concatenation to join a first name and a surname with a space.
examples.zh: 练习表用「字符串拼接」把名字和姓氏连接起来，中间加一个空格。

examples.en: The JavaScript tutor showed when the plus operator performed string concatenation in the sample.
examples.zh: JavaScript 导师演示了样本中的加号运算符在何时执行「字符串拼接」。

words.enDefinition: a string containing no text units

examples.en: The example returned an empty string when the user cleared the sample label field.
examples.zh: 用户清空样本标签字段后，示例返回「空字符串」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether adding an empty string would change the greeting's length.
examples.zh: 导师问，加上一个「空字符串」是否会改变问候语的长度。

words.enDefinition: a contiguous sequence taken from within a string

examples.en: We extracted a substring containing the month from the short date shown in class.
examples.zh: 我们从课堂展示的简短日期里提取了包含月份的「子字符串」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the same substring appeared twice in the sample word.
examples.zh: 导师问，同一个「子字符串」是否在样本单词中出现了两次。

words.enDefinition: accessing a position in a string using an index

examples.en: The Python example used string indexing to read the first letter of the sample word.
examples.zh: Python 示例通过「字符串索引」读取样本单词的首字母。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how JavaScript string indexing accesses code units in the illustrated example.
examples.zh: 导师演示了 JavaScript「字符串索引」在所示示例中如何访问码元。

words.enDefinition: a defined collection of characters supported by a system or standard

examples.en: The exercise used a character set containing Greek letters and basic punctuation for the sample labels.
examples.zh: 练习给样本标签使用了包含希腊字母和基本标点的「字符集」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked which symbols belonged to the character set before discussing how to encode them.
examples.zh: 导师先核对哪些符号属于「字符集」，再讨论怎样编码。

collocations: the characters in a character set

words.enDefinition: a standard assigning code points to characters and defining related text rules

examples.en: The tutor introduced Unicode using examples from two writing systems shown on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师用练习表上两种文字系统的例子介绍「统一码」。

examples.en: We checked the Unicode chart to identify the symbol in the sample sentence.
examples.zh: 我们查阅「统一码」表来识别样本句子中的符号。

words.zhGloss: 美国信息交换标准代码
words.enDefinition: a seven-bit character code covering basic Latin text and control characters
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国信息交换标准代码
acceptedEnVariants: American Standard Code for Information Interchange

examples.en: The worksheet found the ASCII code for the capital letter in our sample label.
examples.zh: 练习表找出了样本标签中那个大写字母的「美国信息交换标准代码」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked which characters of the greeting could be represented in ASCII.
examples.zh: 导师检查了问候语中的哪些字符可以用「美国信息交换标准代码」表示。

words.enDefinition: a Unicode encoding using one to four bytes per scalar value

examples.en: The classroom file used UTF-8 to store both an English greeting and an accented name.
examples.zh: 课堂文件用「UTF-8 编码」存储一句英语问候语和一个带重音符号的姓名。

examples.en: We compared the number of bytes in two sample words after encoding them as UTF-8.
examples.zh: 我们将两个样本单词转为「UTF-8 编码」后，比较了它们的字节数。

words.enDefinition: a Unicode encoding using one or two sixteen-bit units per scalar value

examples.en: The tutor used UTF-16 to explain why one symbol required two units in the example.
examples.zh: 导师用「UTF-16 编码」解释为什么示例里的一个符号需要两个码元。

examples.en: Our worksheet showed why UTF-16 uses one code unit for some symbols and two for others.
examples.zh: 练习表演示了为什么「UTF-16 编码」对一些符号用一个码元，对另一些符号用两个。

words.enDefinition: a number identifying a position in a coded character set

examples.en: We looked up the code point of the accented letter in the classroom character chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂字符表中查找那个带重音字母的「码点」。

examples.en: Our tutor distinguished a code point from the bytes used to store it.
examples.zh: 导师区分了「码点」和用于存储它的字节。

words.enDefinition: a fixed-width unit used within a particular text encoding

examples.en: The worksheet counted each code unit in the JavaScript string and compared the result with its visible characters.
examples.zh: 练习表先数 JavaScript 字符串里各个「码元」，再拿结果与可见字符数比较。

examples.en: Our tutor showed that a UTF-16 code unit occupies sixteen bits in the example.
examples.zh: 导师展示了示例中的一个 UTF-16「码元」占十六位。

words.enDefinition: a Unicode code point outside the surrogate range

examples.en: The tutor explained why a high surrogate alone was not a Unicode scalar value.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么单个高代理码点不属于「Unicode 标量值」。

examples.en: The example represented one Unicode scalar value with a pair of UTF-16 code units.
examples.zh: 示例用一对 UTF-16 码元表示一个「Unicode 标量值」。

words.enDefinition: a high and low UTF-16 surrogate in sequence representing a supplementary scalar

examples.en: The exercise used a surrogate pair to represent the supplementary symbol shown on the screen.
examples.zh: 练习用一个「代理对」表示屏幕上显示的补充平面符号。

examples.en: We counted two code units for the surrogate pair in the sample JavaScript string.
examples.zh: 我们在 JavaScript 样本字符串里把一个「代理对」计为两个码元。

collocations: represent a character with a surrogate pair

words.enDefinition: a character that combines with another character in displayed text

examples.en: The worksheet showed a combining mark after the base letter in the decomposed example.
examples.zh: 在分解形式的示例中，练习表在基本字母之后列出了一个「组合标记」。

examples.en: The tutor added a combining mark to demonstrate why the text still looked like one letter.
examples.zh: 导师添加一个「组合标记」，展示为什么这段文本看起来仍像一个字母。

collocations: a combining mark after a base letter
a character sequence containing a combining mark

words.enDefinition: a text segment that approximates a single user-perceived character

examples.en: Our worksheet treated the letter and its accent mark as one grapheme cluster for counting.
examples.zh: 练习表计数时，把字母和它的重音标记视为一个「字素簇」。

examples.en: The tutor counted a grapheme cluster rather than individual code points in the displayed example.
examples.zh: 导师在示例中按「字素簇」计数，每个字素簇可能包含多个码点。

collocations: treat text as a grapheme cluster

words.enDefinition: converting Unicode text to a standard form according to rules for canonical or compatibility equivalence

examples.en: The class used Unicode normalization to compare two code point sequences for the same word.
examples.zh: 同学们用「Unicode 规范化」比较同一个单词的两个码点序列。

examples.en: We inspected the code points before and after Unicode normalization in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们查看了课堂示例执行「Unicode 规范化」前后的码点。

words.enDefinition: a Unicode relationship between sequences representing the same abstract characters

examples.en: The tutor illustrated canonical equivalence using a precomposed letter and a matching decomposed letter sequence.
examples.zh: 导师用一个预组字符和对应的分解字母序列说明「规范等价」。

examples.en: Our worksheet checked canonical equivalence before testing whether the two sequences had identical code points.
examples.zh: 练习表先检查「规范等价」，再检查两个序列的码点是否完全相同。

collocations: a Unicode rule for canonical equivalence

words.enDefinition: the Unicode form obtained by canonical decomposition and reordering followed by canonical composition where allowed

examples.en: We applied normalization form C so canonically equivalent strings used the same composed form.
examples.zh: 我们应用「规范化形式 C」，使规范等价的字符串使用相同的组合形式。

examples.en: The tutor showed which code points could combine under normalization form C in the example.
examples.zh: 导师展示了示例中哪些码点可以在「规范化形式 C」下重新组合。

collocations: convert text to normalization form C

words.enDefinition: the Unicode form obtained by canonical decomposition and canonical ordering of the resulting code points

examples.en: The worksheet used normalization form D to separate the example's accented letter into its components.
examples.zh: 练习表用「规范化形式 D」把示例中的带重音字母分解成各个成分。

examples.en: Our tutor inspected the code points produced by normalization form D for the sample word.
examples.zh: 导师查看样本单词经「规范化形式 D」处理之后产生的码点。

collocations: convert text to normalization form D

words.enDefinition: an optional initial marker that can indicate an encoding or byte order

examples.en: The example file began with a byte order mark indicating the order used for UTF-16.
examples.zh: 示例文件以一个「字节序标记」开头，用来表示 UTF-16 采用的字节顺序。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the byte order mark should not be counted as part of the greeting.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「字节序标记」不应算作问候语的一部分。

collocations: a file starting with a byte order mark

words.enDefinition: to represent text as bytes using an encoding

examples.en: The Python exercise asked us to encode text before saving the short greeting as bytes.
examples.zh: Python 练习要求我们先「对文本编码」，再以字节保存这句简短问候语。

examples.en: We used UTF-8 to encode text containing both an English greeting and an accented name.
examples.zh: 我们用 UTF-8「对文本编码」，文本里包含英语问候语和带重音符号的姓名。

collocations: encode text using a chosen character encoding

words.enDefinition: to recover text from bytes using an encoding

examples.en: The worksheet asked us to decode bytes from a short sample saved with a known encoding.
examples.zh: 练习表要求按已知编码「将一小段样本字节解码为文本」。

examples.en: Our tutor demonstrated how to decode bytes before comparing the resulting greeting with its original text.
examples.zh: 导师演示了怎样「将字节解码为文本」，再把得到的问候语和原文比较。

collocations: decode bytes using the original encoding
